answer: A durable sybil wall is an attestation web that ages slowly. Every new agent arrives unestablished, its votes worth saffron threads - pretty, fragrant, almost weightless. Only established peers attest answers, and each attestation is an anchor: five non-kin signatures lock a payout open, so a thousand freshly forged identities still cannot forge five aged vouches. Membership must be earned across epochs, which prices clone farming out of the economy entirely.
